req.title: Task deletion persists
req.statement: The system shall remove deleted rows so subsequent GET returns 404 for that id.

doc.reasoning: R-TASK-023 requires that deleting a task via DELETE /tasks/{task_id} removes the row so a subsequent GET /tasks/{task_id} returns 404. The suite covers: (1) positive EP — delete an existing task, verify 204, then verify GET returns 404; (2) negative NEG — delete a non-existent task_id, verify 404 immediately; (3) boundary BVA — delete the lowest valid id (id=1) and highest valid id (id=20) to catch off-by-one mutations in id filtering; (4) STC — full state transition: create → GET 200 → DELETE 204 → GET 404, verifying the state machine is correct; (5) DT — double-delete (idempotency failure path): first DELETE succeeds (204), second DELETE must return 404, not 204 again.

preconditions: Database is pre-loaded with 20 rows including id=7 (Fix login bug, completed=false)
FastAPI app is running in-process via TestClient
expected: Subsequent GET returns HTTP 404 Not Found

tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app
from app import models
from app.database import engine, SessionLocal

models.Base.metadata.drop_all(bind=engine)
models.Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine)
db = SessionLocal()
from datetime import datetime
task = models.Task(id=7, title='Fix login bug', description='Ember willow nova meridian flux cascade zenith.', completed=False, created_at=datetime(2025, 5, 22, 2, 41, 54))
db.add(task)
db.commit()
db.close()

client = TestClient(app)

def test_delete_existing_task_returns_204_and_subsequent_get_returns_404():
    r_del = client.delete('/tasks/7')
    assert r_del.status_code == 204
    assert r_del.content == b''
    r_get = client.get('/tasks/7')
    assert r_get.status_code == 404
    body = r_get.json()
    assert 'detail' in body
    assert '7' in body['detail']

tests.name: test_delete_state_transition_create_get_delete_get
preconditions: FastAPI app is running in-process via TestClient
actions: POST /tasks/ to create a new task
expected: POST returns 201 with id, title, completed=false
GET before delete returns 200 with matching title
GET after delete returns 404 — state transition complete
trace: R-TASK-023: full state machine — created -> exists -> deleted -> absent
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app
from app import models
from app.database import engine

models.Base.metadata.drop_all(bind=engine)
models.Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine)

client = TestClient(app)

def test_delete_state_transition_create_get_delete_get():
    r_create = client.post('/tasks/', json={'title': 'STC Task', 'description': 'state test', 'completed': False})
    assert r_create.status_code == 201
    body_create = r_create.json()
    assert body_create['title'] == 'STC Task'
    assert body_create['completed'] == False
    task_id = body_create['id']
    assert isinstance(task_id, int)

    r_get1 = client.get(f'/tasks/{task_id}')
    assert r_get1.status_code == 200
    assert r_get1.json()['id'] == task_id
    assert r_get1.json()['title'] == 'STC Task'

    r_del = client.delete(f'/tasks/{task_id}')
    assert r_del.status_code == 204
    assert r_del.content == b''

    r_get2 = client.get(f'/tasks/{task_id}')
    assert r_get2.status_code == 404
    assert str(task_id) in r_get2.json()['detail']

actions: Send DELETE /tasks/3 — second deletion of same id

from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app
from app import models
from app.database import engine, SessionLocal
from datetime import datetime

models.Base.metadata.drop_all(bind=engine)
models.Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine)
db = SessionLocal()
task = models.Task(id=3, title='Submit expense report', description='Pulse willow delta willow prism zenith.', completed=True, created_at=datetime(2025, 5, 4, 12, 3, 37))
db.add(task)
db.commit()
db.close()

client = TestClient(app)

def test_double_delete_second_returns_404():
    r1 = client.delete('/tasks/3')
    assert r1.status_code == 204
    assert r1.content == b''

    r2 = client.delete('/tasks/3')
    assert r2.status_code == 404
    body = r2.json()
    assert 'detail' in body
    assert '3' in body['detail']
